tenderSchedule.title: PC-1513 Establishment of transformer repair centre in Humnabad and carrying out repairs to faulty 25/63/100 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 25/63/100 KVA BEE Star Rated (3/4/5 Star Rated) Distribution Transformers of O&M Humnabad Sub-division as per GESCOM specifications with 35 percentage of Fresh Oil and remaining portion by reclaiming burnt oil from the faulty Distribution Transformers (80 Percentage of burnt oil provided by the GESCOM)
tenderSchedule.description: PC-1513 Establishment of transformer repair centre in Humnabad and carrying out repairs to faulty 25/63/100 KVA conventional type (including CSP type) and 25/63/100 KVA BEE Star Rated (3/4/5 Star Rated) Distribution Transformers of O&M Humnabad Sub-division as per GESCOM specifications with 35 percentage of Fresh Oil and remaining portion by reclaiming burnt oil from the faulty Distribution Transformers (80 Percentage of burnt oil provided by the GESCOM) by collecting the faulty transformers available at O&M Division Humnabad GESCOM divisional store for a period of One year.
tenderSchedule.locationName: GESCOM Superintending Engineer Procurement Corporate Office Gulbarga

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should not be less than 50% the amount put to tender during the last Three (3) financial years i.e. 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26.The Audited balance sheet (including profit and loss account sheet) for the said financial years duly signed by the CAs with UDIN and by authorized signatory of the firm shall be scanned and uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders shall upload Liquid assets (Cash at Bank Plus Term Deposit in any Nationalized or Scheduled Commercial Bank) on or after the date of notification of tender plus Availability of credit facility in an Nationalized or Scheduled Commercial Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender, which shall be supported by certificate issued by any Nationalized or Scheduled Commercial Bank. The said Credit Facility Certificate should possess in the name of the Firm and tender Indent number and the credit facility to be issued in the in the Format Annexed to this bid (ANNEXURE-A). The conditional credit certificates are liable for rejection. Documents to this effect shall be uploaded in the given format.

The Bidder should possess statutory certificates such as UDYAM/DIC/SSI/MSME issued by Govt. of Karnataka/India for manufacturing/repair of distribution transformers or repair of any electrical equipment's. Documents to this effect shall be uploaded.

The Bidder shall upload self-declaration of having Diploma/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering or else shall employ 1 (one) number of qualified person who have Diploma/Degree in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics Engineering to supervise the process of repair works. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall be capable of repairing minimum 35 No's of transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) per month and shall be capable for setting up necessary infrastructure at the location as per the scope of the work for repairs within 30days from the date of awarding the work and submit the necessary statutory clearance certificate/authorization letters from concerned authority i.e. Karnataka state Pollution Control Board for the newly established repair center within 90days from the date of issue of LOI, failing to which GESCOM reserves the right to cancel the DWA. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall possess the registration of EPF, ESI, GST, labor license certificate (form-C for establishment) and PAN card issued by the respective competent authorities of the concerned department. The copy of original registration documents shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall agree to install web-based CCTV cameras at his own cost as per the GESCOM requirement for monitoring of all the activities in the repair center by the GESCOM, within 30 days from the date of award. The video footage shall be preserved by the bidder and also it is to be presented as and when requested by the GESCOM authorities. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded

In case of the bidder is a manufacture, the bidder must have manufactured and supplied minimum of 450 Nos of Distribution Transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) to ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India/Total Turnkey/Partial Turnkey works during the last Five (5) Financial years put together. (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) or In case the bidder is a repairer, bidder (transformers repairer) should have repaired a minimum of 225 Nos of failed Distribution Transformers (of any capacities/ratings in total) in any ESCOM of Karnataka in any one of the last Five (5) Financial years. (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) In case the bidder is manufacture, the copy of the order completion certificate for having supplied 450 Nos of Distribution Transformers (of any capacities /ratings in total) against the Purchase Orders/Award issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India duly mentioning PO/Award No. date and quantity and financial year of supply shall be scanned and uploaded. or In case the bidder is a repairer, the copy of the order completion certificate having repaired 225 Nos of failed Distribution Transformers duly mentioning Award No/PO number and date, quantity repaired, financial year of repair issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs in Karnataka shall be scanned and uploaded.

In case of the bidder is a manufacture: For the above, Financial Year wise(i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) Performance certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India shall be scanned and uploaded. Failure of Distribution Transformers within the Guarantee period should not exceed 6% (Six per cent). Or In case of the bidder is a repairer: For the above, Financial Year wise(i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) Performance certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India shall be scanned and uploaded. Failure of Distribution Transformers within the Guarantee period should not exceed 6% (Six per cent). In case of the bidder is a manufacture: Performance certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India duly mentioning number of transformers supplied, failed within Guarantee Period (WGP) and the percentage failure within guarantee period shall be scanned and uploaded.or In case of the bidder is a repairer: Performance certificate issued by not below the rank of Executive Engineer of ESCOMs/any Govt. Electrical Utilities in India duly mentioning number of transformers repaired, failed within Guarantee Period (WGP) and the percentage failure within guarantee period shall be scanned and uploaded.

The bidder shall purchase the DPC wire, EHV grade transformers oil and any other materials required etc., as per IS specifications from manufacture/authorized dealers only in the name of bidder. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder should not have been Black-Listed/short closed/terminated from his contract due to non-performance in execution of works against the order placed by ESCOMs/KPTCL/any other Government Distribution/Transmission utilities including PSUs as on date of bid submission. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contract completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL/ESCOMS. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part may result in rejection of bid.Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.

A.The Bidder shall not hold more than Three (3) Transformer Repair Center contract in any of the ESCOMs of Karnataka at any point of time. However, the bidders whose existing Transformer Repair Center contracts in any of the ESCOMs are expiring within next Six (6) months from the date of publication of this tender are eligible to participate. Self-declaration in this regard duly mentioning the list of existing transformer repair centers if any shall be submitted. If the self-declaration certificate found to be false then GESCOM reserves the right to reject the bid at any time. B. The Bidder shall not hold more than Three (3) Transformer Repair Center contract in any of the ESCOMs of Karnataka at any point of time. However, the bidders whose existing Transformer Repair Center contracts in any of the ESCOMs are expiring within next Six (6) months from the date of publication of this tender are eligible to participate. Self-declaration in this regard duly mentioning the list of existing transformer repair centers if any shall be submitted. If the self-declaration certificate found to be false then GESCOM reserves the right to reject the bid at any time. C. In case the bidder is awarded under this tender and the extension if any provided to the existing contracts in other ESCOMs results in the total number of contracts exceeding Three (3), the bidder shall surrender or forgo such extended contracts so as to ensure that the total number of contracts held by the bidder does not exceed Three (3) at any point of time. The bidder shall submit an undertaking to this effect along with the bid. D. In Case the bidder fails to surrender or forego such extended contracts, GESCOM reserves the right to reject the participated or awarded tenders. The bidder shall submit an undertaking to this effect along with the bid

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration and Under taking

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the bidder has participated in more than one bid, the bidder shall fulfill the conditions in QR at clause (6), (7), (11) and (12) for Work done, Performance, annual turnover and Liquid assets cumulatively for all tender enquiries participated respectively. If this condition is not met, then the offer of the bidder will be considered for the tender enquiry for which the bidder is eligible at the discretion of GESCOM.Acceptance in this regard shall be uploaded.
The successful bidder shall establish the repair shed with required power supply at their own cost. Self-declaration for the same on notarized stamp paper of Rs.100/- shall be uploaded.
